arxiv-1912-02312.title: Exploring hybrid equation of state with constraints from tidal deformability of GW170817
arxiv-1912-02312.creator: Qing-Wu Wang, Chao Shi, Yan Yan, Hong-Shi Zong
arxiv-1912-02312.description: Abstract With a interpolation method on the P- μ \mu plane, a hybrid equation of state is explored. The quark phase is described by our newly developed self-consistent two-flavor Nambu − - Jona-Lasinio model. It retains the contribution from the vector channel in the Fierz-transformed Lagrangian by introducing a weighting parameter α \alpha [Chin. Phys. C 43 , 084102 (2019)].

arxiv-2204-01790.title: Leaders or Followers? A Temporal Analysis of Tweets from IRA Trolls
arxiv-2204-01790.creator: Siva K. Balasubramanian, Mustafa Bilgic, Aron Culotta, Libby Hemphill, Anita Nikolich, Matthew A. Shapiro
arxiv-2204-01790.description: Abstract The Internet Research Agency (IRA) influences online political conversations in the United States, exacerbating existing partisan divides and sowing discord. In this paper we investigate the IRA’s communication strategies by analyzing trending terms on Twitter to identify cases in which the IRA leads or follows other users.

arxiv-2204-12013.title: Bamboo: Making Preemptible Instances Resilient for Affordable Training of Large DNNs
arxiv-2204-12013.creator: John Thorpe Pengzhan Zhao Jonathan Eyolfson Yifan Qiao Zhihao Jia, [.3em]Minjia Zhang Ravi Netravali Guoqing Harry Xu, [.3em] UCLA CMU Microsoft Research Princeton University[1em]
arxiv-2204-12013.description: Abstract DNN models across many domains continue to grow in size, resulting in high resource requirements for effective training, and unpalatable (and often unaffordable) costs for organizations and research labs across scales. In particular, we prove an upper bound on the number of points on and near large dilates of the unit spheres generated by the anisotropic norms ‖ ( z , t ) ‖ α = ( | z | α + | t | α / 2 ) 1 / α \|(z,t)\|_{\alpha}=(\left|z\right|^{\alpha}+\left|t\right|^{\alpha/2})^{1/\alpha} for α ≥ 2 \alpha\geq 2 .

arxiv-2302-12458.title: Design and Mechanics of Cable-Driven Rolling Diaphragm Transmission for High-Transparency Robotic Motion
arxiv-2302-12458.creator: Hoi Man Lam, W. Jared Walker, Lucas Jonasch, Dimitri Schreiber, and Michael C. Yip
arxiv-2302-12458.description: Abstract Applications of rolling diaphragm transmissions for medical and teleoperated robotics are of great interest, due to the low friction of rolling diaphragms combined with the power density and stiffness of hydraulic transmissions. However, the stiffness-enabling pressure preloads can form a tradeoff against bearing loading in some rolling diaphragm layouts, and transmission setup can be difficult.

arxiv-2409-06055.title: Short-Timescale Spatial Variability of Ganymede’s Optical Aurora Facilities: W. M. Keck Observatory (Keck I/HIRES)
arxiv-2409-06055.creator: Zachariah Milby, Katherine de Kleer, Carl Schmidt, François Leblanc
arxiv-2409-06055.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zachariah Milby, Katherine de Kleer, Carl Schmidt, François Leblanc. Ganymede’s aurora are the product of complex interactions between its intrinsic magnetosphere and the surrounding Jovian plasma environment and can be used to derive both atmospheric composition and density. In this study, we analyzed a time-series of Ganymede’s optical aurora taken with Keck I/HIRES during eclipse by Jupiter on 2021-06-08 UTC , one day after the Juno flyby of Ganymede.

arxiv-2507-17605.title: Parallel (co-)tractors and the geometry of first BGG solutions on almost Grassmannian structures
arxiv-2507-17605.creator: Zhangwen Guo
arxiv-2507-17605.description: Abstract We study the standard tractor bundle and the standard cotractor bundle of an almost Grassmann structure: We provide explicit formulae for their splitting operators, first BGG operators as well as prolongation connections. We characterize parallel tractors and cotractors as well as the solutions of the BGG operators in standard geometric terms.

arxiv-2602-09976.title: Corrigendum to “Higher Lorentzian polynomials, higher Hessians, and the Hodge-Riemann relations for graded oriented Artinian Gorenstein algebras in codimension two”, [International Mathematics Research Notices, Volume 2025, Issue 13, July 2025]
arxiv-2602-09976.creator: Pedro Macias Marques, Chris McDaniel, Alexandra Seceleanu
arxiv-2602-09976.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Pedro Macias Marques, Chris McDaniel, Alexandra Seceleanu. A homogeneous bivariate d d -form defines an ( i + 1 ) (i+1) -rowed Toeplitz matrix for each i i between 0 0 and d d . We use Hodge theory and Schur polynomials to prove that if the ( i + 1 ) (i+1) -rowed Toeplitz matrix of a form is totally nonnegative, then so is the i i -rowed one. This fixes a gap in the main result of paper above.

pmc-11401142.title: Targeting mTOR signaling for the treatment of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with TSC1/ARID1A mutations: a case report with an unexpected response
pmc-11401142.creator: Clémentine Daugan, Romain Boidot, François Ghiringhelli, Christophe Borg, Angélique Vienot
pmc-11401142.description: Biliary tract cancer incidence is increasing and the prognostic remains dismal. The development of personalized medicine is a pivotal issue in proposing therapeutic options for biliary tract cancer patients. Whole exome sequencing identifies approximately 15% of IDH1 mutations and 15% of FGFR2 fusions in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. Other patients are not currently eligible for targeted therapy.

pmc-11443913.title: Role and molecular mechanisms of HuangQiSiJunZi decoction for treating triple-negative breast cancer as explored via network pharmacology and bioinformatics analyses
pmc-11443913.creator: Decai Wang, Dongqing Xie, Shuai Meng, Jiwei MI, Haiming Wang, Lingsheng Li, Yin Zhang, Yixin Cui
pmc-11443913.description: ObjectiveIn this study, we evaluated the molecular mechanisms of HuangQiSiJunZi Decoction (HQSJZD) for treating triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) using network pharmacology and bioinformatics analyses.MethodsEffective chemical components together with action targets of HQSJZD were selected based on the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform (TCMSP).

pmc-11502423.title: Risk factors associated with antibiotic prescriptions for cases of enteric pathogens in Canada, 2015–2019
pmc-11502423.creator: Brendan Dougherty, Rita Finley, Danielle Dumoulin, J Scott Weese, Sherilee Harper, E Jane Parmley, Andrew Papadopoulos
pmc-11502423.description: Inappropriate antibiotic use is a key driver of antibiotic resistance and one that can be mitigated through stewardship. A better understanding of current prescribing practices is needed to develop successful stewardship efforts. This study aims to identify factors that are associated with human cases of enteric illness receiving an antibiotic prescription.

pmc-11521741.title: Bread consumption trends in Poland: A socio‐economic perspective and factors affecting current intake
pmc-11521741.creator: Adam Sadowski, Bogusława Dobrowolska, Piotr Dziugan, Ilona Motyl, Wiktoria Liszkowska, Izabela Rydlewska‐Liszkowska, Joanna Berłowska
pmc-11521741.description: Fermentation processes have been known since ancient times and are widely used in the production of food, beverages, and other areas. One of the most well‐known fermented products is bread. It plays an important role in human nutrition because of the valuable compounds it contains. The growing population leads to an increase in global bread consumption and other bakery products.

pmc-11689333.title: MEASURING NATIONAL TRENDS IN SOCIAL ISOLATION AND LONELINESS AMONG OLDER ADULTS AND THEIR CAREGIVERS
pmc-11689333.creator: Mary Louise Pomeroy, Yiqing Qian, Katherine Ornstein
pmc-11689333.description: Social isolation and loneliness have negative implications for the health and care of older adults. Few studies have examined longitudinal patterns of social isolation and loneliness among older adults, or how these experiences are shared by caregivers and personal care networks.

pmc-12531343.title: Postoperative detection of pulmonary artery catheter entrapment during minimally invasive mitral valve repair: a case report
pmc-12531343.creator: Ayaka Higashi, Sachiko Yamazaki, Atsushi Kainuma, Toshihito Mihara, Yuya Takahashi, Hiroki Matsuyama, Akiyuki Takahashi, Masahiro Sakaguchi
pmc-12531343.description: BackgroundPulmonary artery catheter (PAC) entrapment is a rare but serious complication caused by inadvertent suturing to cardiac or vascular structures.Case presentationA 42-year-old man underwent minimally invasive mitral valve repair via right mini-thoracotomy. Thirty minutes after weaning from cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB), pulmonary artery pressure suddenly dropped, and the waveform became identical to that of central venous pressure.

pmc-13091563.title: Localized phosphoinositide metabolism regulates STIM1/ORAI1 fast inactivation
pmc-13091563.creator: Ning Dai, Shawn M Lamothe, Jody Groenendyk, Nicolas Touret, Harley T Kurata, Marek Michalak
pmc-13091563.description: SummaryStore-operated Ca2+ entry (SOCE) is central for maintaining cellular Ca2+ homeostasis, and it is initiated by the depletion of Ca2+ in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and activation of stromal interaction molecule 1 (STIM1). STIM1 acts as an ER Ca2+ sensor and engages with plasma membrane ORAI1 channels to facilitate ORAI1 activation and Ca2+ influx.

pmc-13409236.title: Effectiveness of Guselkumab for the Treatment of Moderate-to- Severe Psoriasis in Elderly Patients: A Retrospective, Real-World Multicenter Study in the Lazio Region

pmc-13470221.title: G-quadruplex homeostasis is a determinant of PARP inhibitor toxicity in BRCA2-deficient cells
pmc-13470221.creator: Abhishek Bharadwaj Sharma, Joanna Krwawicz, Leandre Tappenden, Muhammad Khairul Ramlee, Arwa A Abugable, Xin Zhen, Simran Khurana, Travis H Stracker, Nicholas D Lakin
pmc-13470221.description: Inhibition of PARPs is a key strategy to treat tumours with defects in homologous recombination (HR), including those with mutations in the tumour suppressor gene BRCA2. PARP inhibitors generate replication stress, creating a dependence on HR to repair the resulting DNA damage.

pmc-13623069.title: A Multidisciplinary, Digitally-Integrated Life-Cycle Management Model for Early Gastrointestinal Cancer: Enhancing Care Coordination and Continuity
pmc-13623069.creator: Rui Yuan, Hui Gong, Chuanjun Tang, Bing Hu, Jinhang Gao, Hao Wu, Wenjuan Yang
pmc-13623069.description: ObjectiveTo describe a multidisciplinary, digitally integrated life-cycle management framework for early gastrointestinal (GI) cancer and present its development and preliminary implementation experience within a high-volume tertiary center.MethodsThis narrative review synthesizes published evidence, clinical guidelines, policy documents, and preliminary institutional implementation experience related to multidisciplinary coordination, digital infrastructure, risk stratification, and longitudinal follow-up.

pmc-13681029.title: miR2Meth: An R package for dissecting DNA methylation heterogeneity at microRNA promoters
pmc-13681029.creator: Ying Shan, Xiaoshan Rong, Andrew E Teschendorff, Zhen Yang
pmc-13681029.description: Aberrant expression of microRNAs (miRNAs) has been found in prevalent cancer types, yet the underlying mechanisms remain largely unexplored due to a lack of analytical tools. Studies have shown that DNA methylation (DNAm) plays a significant role in regulating miRNA expression.
